Biden's Substack subscribers and a mailing list kept by video journalist Andrew Callaghan also qualify.

The first token called LAPTOP opened on Robinhood Chain about a minute before the Journal's markets account posted the story, and 22 more pools followed over the next 53 minutes across Solana, TON and BNB Chain, covering at least 14 distinct tokens that traded $6.9 million between them.
